Alice K: Heads-up — planning schema migration on user_profiles: add contact_preferences JSONB + backfill. Window Sat 2026-05-09 01:00 UTC. Plan: 30m hot dual-write for 90-day active users, then background backfill. Who can own deploy + smoke?
Samir D: I can. On-call night of. :+1:
Priya N: Quick Q — estimated backfill throughput on prod replica? If it's slow we need a longer dual-write window.
Marco L: Last run we hit ~120k rows/min on n2-highmem replica. Risk: index bloat; will add --concurrency cap. If write pressure spikes we throttle.
Jenna P: Runbook + SQL in ops playbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/db/user_profiles_migration
Jenna P: Reposting smoke checks:
Jenna P: ```
-- migration
ALTER TABLE user_profiles ADD COLUMN contact_preferences JSONB DEFAULT '{}';

-- smoke
SELECT count(*) FROM user_profiles WHERE contact_preferences IS NULL;
SELECT count(*) FROM user_profiles WHERE contact_preferences = '{}';
```
Samir D: Rollback plan: keep compatibility layer in app, toggle feature flag to revert reads. Full DROP/ALTER revert steps are in runbook.
Alice K: Order proposal: start dual-write + quick hot backfill (30m), then continue background. Any objections?
Marco L: No objections. Hot-first avoids churn. I'll prepare a throttled backfill job and a --concurrency flag. ETA to staging: EOD.
Priya N: We'll gate the cutover on replica lag <5s sustained for 10min. Who will run the lag check at cutover?
Samir D: I'll run lag checks and post here. Will page if lag >20s.
deploy-bot: scheduled migration job created: migration-up_user_profiles-20260509-0100 (CI: 7842). Will post at start.
Alice K: App-level smoke: need a quick curl that GETs /api/v1/users/{id} and asserts contact_preferences key present.
Jenna P: Added ./ops/smoke/user_profiles_smoke.sh — hits API and checks for key. Verified on staging.
Marco L: Adding runtime abort: if avg p95 latency >250ms for 2 consecutive minutes, backfill halts.
Samir D: Owners: deploy + initial hot backfill (me), metrics (Priya), backfill control (Marco), smoke scripts (Jenna).
Priya N: I'll add Grafana panels for replica lag, DB write pressure, and app latency; pin to ops board.
Alice K: Final preflight:
- SQL reviewed: yes
- Runbook present: yes
- Rollback defined: yes
- Owners assigned: yes (Samir/Priya/Marco/Jenna)
- CI job scheduled: yes
If no objections I'll close planning.
Samir D: No objections. I'll ping readiness 1h before.
Marco L: Standby during window.
Jenna P: Smoke passed on staging. :white_check_mark:
Priya N: Dashboard pinned. Will post metrics during window.
